questions.question_hindi: CGHS और CS(MA) नियमों के अंतर्गत बच्चों की आश्रित-पात्रता की आयु-सीमा के संबंध में सही युग्म चुनिए।
options_hindi: अविवाहित बेटा — कमाई की स्थिति से स्वतंत्र, 21 वर्ष तक
अविवाहित बेटी — वैवाहिक स्थिति से स्वतंत्र, 25 वर्ष तक
विवाहित बेटी — रोजगार की स्थिति से स्वतंत्र, 18 वर्ष तक
अविवाहित बेटा — 25 वर्ष तक या कमाई शुरू होने तक
questions.question_english: Select the correctly matched pair regarding the age limit for dependency of children under the CGHS and CS(MA) Rules.
options_english: Unmarried Son - Up to 21 years of age, irrespective of earning status
Unmarried Daughter - Up to 25 years of age, irrespective of marital status
Married Daughter - Up to 18 years of age, irrespective of employment status
Unmarried Son - Up to 25 years of age or until he begins earning
questions.explanation_english: Unmarried Son - Up to 25 years of age or until he begins earning. Dependency parameters under central medical rules specify distinct age limits for children. An unmarried son remains an eligible dependent until attaining twenty-five years of age or commencing employment, whichever occurs earlier. Conversely, unmarried daughters remain eligible regardless of age until marriage or employment, while disabled children retain lifelong eligibility if dependent.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है: अविवाहित बेटा — 25 वर्ष तक या कमाई शुरू होने तक। स्रोत में दिए गए स्पष्टीकरण के अनुसार यही नियम, पात्रता-शर्त या प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया इस प्रश्न पर लागू होती है।
key_facts: Answer key: (D)

options_hindi: लाभार्थी की मृत्यु पर इसे भाई या बहन को हस्तांतरित किया जा सकता है

questions.question_english: Select the incorrect statement regarding the CGHS beneficiary ID.
options_english: It can be transferred to a sibling in case of the beneficiary’s death.
It is a unique 7-digit numeric code generated upon enrollment.
It remains the same even if the beneficiary shifts from a serving to a pensioner category.
A dependent child’s ID expires or is deactivated once they cross the dependency age limit.
questions.explanation_english: It can be transferred to a sibling in case of the beneficiary’s death.. Every beneficiary receives a unique, non- transferable identification number that remains unchanged when transitioning from serving status to pensioner status. Upon a beneficiary’s death or when a dependent child exceeds the statutory age limit, that specific identification ID is permanently deactivated and cannot be transferred to siblings or others.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है: लाभार्थी की मृत्यु पर इसे भाई या बहन को हस्तांतरित किया जा सकता है। स्रोत में दिए गए स्पष्टीकरण के अनुसार यही नियम, पात्रता-शर्त या प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया इस प्रश्न पर लागू होती है।
key_facts: Answer key: (A)

questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दिए गए अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) पर विचार कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A): गैर-CGHS क्षेत्र में रहने वाले पेंशनभोगी OPD और IPD दोनों के लिए निश्चित चिकित्सा भत्ता (FMA) या CGHS कार्ड में से विकल्प चुन सकते हैं।
कारण (R): CGHS वेलनेस केंद्रों के दायरे से बाहर रहने वाले लोगों के रोज़मर्रा के OPD खर्चों की भरपाई के लिए सरकार FMA देती है। A और R के संबंध में सही विकल्प चुनिए।
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सही हैं, और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता

questions.question_english: Consider the two statements below: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): Pensioners residing in non-CGHS areas have the option to either avail a Fixed Medical Allowance (FMA) or a CGHS card for both OPD and IPD. Reason (R): The Government provides FMA to compensate for day-to-day medical expenses for OPD treatment for those residing outside the coverage area of CGHS wellness centres.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of. A Pensioners residing outside scheme coverage areas can choose between receiving Fixed Medical Allowance for outpatient expenses or obtaining a scheme pensioner card. The allowance is specifically intended to cover routine day-to-day outpatient expenses where local wellness centres do not exist, making the explanation accurate and directly aligned.

key_facts: Answer key: (A)

options_hindi: बिल पूरी तरह मंजूर करें क्योंकि अधिकृत चिकित्सा परिचर ने उस पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं
यदि मल्टीविटामिन टॉनिक CS(MA) की अपात्र दवा-सूची में है तो राशि अस्वीकार करें

questions.question_english: A school Principal notices that the monthly medical bills of an employee show continuous purchase of multivitamin syrups not tied to any specific disease. The AMA has simply signed the prescription. What should the Principal do before passing the bill?
options_english: Approve the bill completely since it bears the formal signature of the Authorised Medical Attendant
Disallow the amount if multivitamins as tonics are on the CS(MA) inadmissible medicine list
Reamburse double the claimed amount to encourage the employee’s proactive personal health care
Initiate immediate administrative suspension proceedings against the employee for submission
questions.explanation_english: Disallow the amount if multivitamins as tonics are on the CS(MA) inadmissible medicine list. Drawing and Disbursing Officers must audit medical claims against official lists of inadmissible medicines. Multivitamin syrups or general tonics prescribed without specific therapeutic justification fall under inadmissible categories, requiring the Principal as DDO to disallow and deduct those specific tonic amounts prior to sanctioning reimbursement.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: यदि मल्टीविटामिन टॉनिक CS(MA) की अपात्र दवा-सूची में है तो राशि अस्वीकार करें। स्रोत में दिए गए स्पष्टीकरण के अनुसार यही नियम, पात्रता-शर्त या प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया इस प्रश्न पर लागू होती है।
key_facts: Answer key: (B)

questions.question_hindi:
CGHS के अंतर्गत मिलने वाली सुविधाओं के बारे में इन कथनों पर विचार कीजिए।
I. इसमें एलोपैथिक, होम्योपैथिक और AYUSH चिकित्सा-पद्धतियाँ शामिल हैं।
II. यह केवल अस्पताल में भर्ती होकर उपचार लेने तक सीमित है।

options_hindi: केवल I और II
केवल II और III
केवल I और III
I, II और III
questions.question_english: Consider the following statements regarding the coverage of the CGHS: I. It covers allopathic, homeopathic, and AYUSH systems of medicine. II. It is strictly limited to inpatient treatment only. III. It covers the supply of prescribed medicines. Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: I and III only. Central Government Health Scheme provides comprehensive outpatient and inpatient medical care across multiple recognized medical systems, including Allopathy, Homeopathy, Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, and Yoga. Services include consultations, diagnostic testing, emergency handling, and supply of prescribed drugs, making coverage comprehensive rather than restricted exclusively to inpatient hospitalization care.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। स्रोत में दिए गए कथनों में केवल I और III सही हैं। शेष कथन लागू नियमों या स्रोत में दी गई प्रक्रिया से मेल नहीं खाते।
key_facts: Answer key: (C)

questions.question_english: Under the CS(MA) Rules, what does the term “Travelling Allowance” for medical attendance imply?

Travel expense reimbursement for patient and certified attendant consulting an outside specialist
A flat monthly compensatory transport bonus disbursed to non-availed government employees

questions.explanation_english: Travel expense reimbursement for patient and certified attendant consulting an outside specialist. Travelling Allowance under medical attendance rules covers travel expenses incurred when a patient, along with an attendant if certified necessary by the medical officer, must travel to another station to consult a government specialist or receive specialized treatment unavailable at their official duty station.

questions.question_english: What does a “CGHS Package Rate” typically include for a surgical procedure?

A fixed daily allowance covering exclusively the hospital room accommodation and stay charges
A comprehensive fee covering accommodation, surgery, OT, medicines, and routine inpatient care

questions.explanation_english: A comprehensive fee covering accommodation, surgery, OT, medicines, and routine inpatient care. questions.question_english: An employee wishes to include a parent who receives a monthly pension exceeding ₹9,000 plus applicable Dearness Allowance/Relief. Is the parent eligible as a dependent?

No, because the income exceeds the prescribed dependency limit of ₹9,000 plus DA per month

questions.question_english: What happens if a government servant fails to report the death or loss of dependency status of a family member whose name is on the CGHS card?
options_english: The government continues providing medical benefits to the deceased relative as an act of goodwill
The treating empanelled hospital is penalized for failing to verify the official death certificate
The beneficiary card is deactivated by administrative staff without imposing any financial penalty
The employee faces disciplinary action, recovery of costs, and liability for card misuse
questions.explanation_english: The employee faces disciplinary action, recovery of costs, and liability for card misuse.
